name: curtain-blind-realism
description: Verify the reworked window treatments: wavy floor-to-ceiling curtains sized to their window (closed / half / open-clearing-the-window) and a roller blind that lowers/raises. Places treatments on the default flat's windows with window-aware sizing (mirrors windowFixtureProps) and screenshots in orbit + a close walk angle.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: place-treatments
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const plan=s.floorPlan; const ch=plan.ceilingHeight; const walls=plan.walls; const wins=plan.openings.filter(o=>o.kind==='window'); const cx=plan.extent[0]/2, cz=plan.extent[1]/2; const byId=new Map(walls.map(w=>[w.id,w])); const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.min(b,Math.max(a,v)); function snap(op){ const wall=byId.get(op.wallId); const dx=wall.end[0]-wall.start[0], dz=wall.end[1]-wall.start[1]; const len=Math.hypot(dx,dz); const ux=dx/len, uz=dz/len; const cd=op.offset+op.width/2; const wx=wall.start[0]+ux*cd, wz=wall.start[1]+uz*cd; let rot=-Math.atan2(dz,dx); const nx=-uz,nz=ux; if((cx-wx)*nx+(cz-wz)*nz<0) rot+=Math.PI; return {wx,wz,rot}; } const items=[]; const curtainDraws=[1,0.5,0]; let ci=0; wins.forEach((op,idx)=>{ const sn=snap(op); if(idx<3){ const draw=curtainDraws[ci++]; items.push({id:'curt-'+idx,defId:'curtains',position:[sn.wx,sn.wz],rotation:sn.rot,props:{width:clamp(op.width+0.36,1,3.4),height:clamp(ch-0.05,1.8,3.2),color:'#9c6b4f',drawAmount:draw}}); } else { const lower=(idx%2===0)?1:0.4; items.push({id:'blind-'+idx,defId:'roller-blind',position:[sn.wx,sn.wz],rotation:sn.rot,props:{width:clamp(op.width+0.12,0.6,2.8),height:clamp(op.head+0.12,1.8,2.7),drop:clamp(op.head-op.sill+0.24,0.4,2.4),lower:lower,color:'#cdd2cc'}}); } }); s.setItems(items); window.__placed={count:items.length}; })()
